cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Enjoy your afternoon off. Your bike will be ready for tomorrow. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's the repair shop asking me to collect a wheel?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. They've got your number on the ticket. I'll collect everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A wheel? Is the rest at another shop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only until four. Stay with your book; I've planned a route that gets all of it home before you need it.

mechanism: A takes charge of a partner bike repair logistics while negotiating communication preferences to conceal hassle and protect the partner day off.
confusable: Unlike simple repair competence or avoiding blame, A explicitly protects B rest; confident control must accommodate B understandable need for information.
comparison: Scattered bike parts and repair-shop messages differ from a tired partner choosing where to sleep near a concealed leak.
seedUse: Use D39-b wheel/two shops/collection route with S02-a revised coordination presented as a settled plan.
